prompt: A team has no hardware, no special network needs, and wants zero maintenance of build machines. What is the sensible default?
explanation: GitHub-hosted runners arrive maintained: images are updated, software is preinstalled, and each job gets a clean machine. Self-hosting buys control at the price of operating the fleet — a price this team has no reason to pay.

options.text: GitHub-hosted runners — patched and managed by GitHub
A single oversized self-hosted VM under a desk
Running workflows locally with the `act` tool
